_comment: Install-check scenario map (06-01; D-02 option a - scenario-map, runner owns order, doc owns step content). HOW BLOCKS ARE IDENTIFIED: each step references a bash fenced block of an install doc by (doc, heading text, blockIndex), where blockIndex counts fences of the SAME language tag inside the SAME heading section (adding a ```text/```json fence to a section cannot renumber its bash blocks). Block content is NEVER copied here - bin/install_check.js resolves and executes it from the doc at run time (D-02). DRIFT DETECTION: every doc step pins an expectCommand literal - the exact command line the step exists to run; the runner refuses to execute a resolved block that is empty or does not contain the literal, naming the step's heading + blockIndex and the missing literal (INSTALL-02). Output expectations are named via harnessAssert (mysql_dialect, redis_pong) and defined in the runner, never parsed from doc prose (D-06). WHO CONSUMES IT: bin/install_check.js (slice execution order = this file's array order, doc order is not execution order), and t/unit/install_scenario_manifest.js (companion gate: every bash block of the doc is either a scenario step or an exclusion below, every step resolves to a real fence - orphan blocks and phantom steps both fail CI). WHERE IT IS CI-GATED: plan 06-02 wires .github/workflows/core-ci.yml install jobs to `node bin/install_check.js --slice docker` / `--slice npm`; the literal doc commands (e.g. `npm install`) never appear in workflow yml (t/unit/ci_install_commands.js guard, 05 D-15). SCOPE (D-08): exactly the two install docs - docs/docker-compose.md now, docs/install-local-npm.md from plan 06-02 (-slice npm). EXCLUSIONS (D-05): the parser executes only community install sections (env prep, normal start, migrations, health checks, first admin, teardown); every bash block outside that coverage is listed below with a reason. The premium-scheduler section (### 4) carries only ```env fences - no bash block exists there to exclude.

exclusions.heading: Commercial запуск с private premium module
exclusions.reason: D-05: commercial build path - builds with a private premium module from a host path via docker-compose.commercial.yml; the private repository is not reproducible on a community checkout or in CI.

exclusions.heading: Commercial запуск с private premium module
exclusions.reason: D-05: premium development override (docker-compose.premium-dev.yml, NODE_ENV=development) - same private premium repository, not reproducible outside a vendor machine.

exclusions.heading: 3. Настройте ежедневные reminder-уведомления
exclusions.reason: D-05: optional opt-in - recreates the app container to enable the reminder scheduler after the baseline install; outside the D-05 community install sections (env prep, normal start, migrations, health checks, first admin).

exclusions.heading: 3. Настройте ежедневные reminder-уведомления
exclusions.reason: D-05: manual/emergency reminder run for departments with reminders enabled - an ops action over a running installation, not an install step.

exclusions.heading: Проверка сессий
exclusions.reason: D-05: manual browser-session check (the section's own step 1 is 'log in via browser'); the automated contour proves sessions through its own login flow instead of counting Redis keys.

exclusions.heading: Docker Compose для разработки
exclusions.reason: D-05: development contour with mounted sources and watch mode - the install gate covers the operator path, not the developer one.

exclusions.heading: Просто остановить
exclusions.reason: teardown sibling: the scenario tears the stand down with the -v block (Остановить и удалить тома) so a disposable stand never leaves test volumes behind; plain down is the operator's data-preserving stop and is meaningless against a stand the scenario removes.

exclusions.heading: Когда выключать `RUN_DB_MIGRATIONS`
exclusions.reason: duplicate of the миграции block (2. Примените миграции) - the same db-update command shown in the RUN_DB_MIGRATIONS section for the controlled-rollout path; the scenario executes the миграции-section block.
